description: Twelve more random gates for Seeds of Change, drawn from its seed and its clock; it goes immediately to the right of Seeds of Change or of another of its expanders

params.text: Sets the chance that row's gate fires on a clock, 0 to 100%
Sets how far that row's PROBABILITY input moves the chance, and in which direction
Switches that row's gate output between following the clock and firing a short trigger

inputs.text: Voltage that moves that row's gate chance, by the amount that row's attenuverter sets

outputs.text: Fires when that row's chance allows it on a clock, carrying the clock voltage while the clock is high, or a short trigger with that row's MODE set to trigger
